notes.title: Game Retirement
notes.content: The game will be retired from Steam. The forums will remain open if there are any questions or concerns.

notes.title: Tier 4 content released!
notes.content:
The 4th tier of content is now available! If you're currently at Mission Hall level 18, you'll need to clear one existing A or S rank mission. Afterwards, a "High Rank" button will appear in the mission select menu.

The new regions have new music. Be sure to listen.

If you experience any issues, be sure to post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com.

notes.title: Game Update: Build 140
notes.content: In order to fix a few strange and peculiar issues, logins were temporarily disabled and the game was update to build 140. The issues should be fixed, but if you encounter any problems within the game, be sure to either post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com right away.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Majula Frontier: The Offense is now available to play!

If you have questions about the mechanics, there's a mechanics thread in the forums.

If you experience issues, be sure to post in the forums or email Support@EFUniverseGames.com
